title: Titanroot Skies
description: A Minecraft society modpack with a focus on mechanical engineering, exploration, and rpg elements.
body:
A Minecraft society modpack with a focus on mechanical engineering, exploration, and RPG elements.


Mainly featuring a slew of Create mod and Create mod add-ons along with ZsoltMolnarrr's RPG Series mods to allow for better combat.


### Next possible features
Linking mod to connect the different mod systems together, working on it lol.
